Name: Shuthelah, Son of Zabad
Summary: Son of Zabad and father of Ezer and Elead in Ephraim's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:21: Son of Zabad and father of Ezer and Elead in Ephraim's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shuthelah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
